anilist_detail.synopsis: The third season of Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu.

Lady Carolina, the overlooked daughter of a powerful duke, has always believed herself to be the black sheep amid her illustrious kin. Her father is the distinguished prime minister; her elder sister, a prodigious mage destined to become their nation’s next Saint. In comparison, Carolina resigns herself to a quiet existence in their shadows until a sudden and unexpected royal decree alters her destiny, thrusting her into a political marriage with the formidable “Bloodthirsty Prince” of the neighboring Empire of Malcosias. Determined to prove her worth, Carolina takes a bold step into a world fraught with both political and mortal peril. As royal obligations intertwine with hints of true love and the stirrings of her own latent power, Carolina moves ever closer to understanding what it truly means to be exceptional.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Ichigo Kurosaki is a rather normal high school student apart from the fact he has the ability to see ghosts. This ability never impacted his life in a major way until the day he encounters the Shinigami Kuchiki Rukia, who saves him and his family's lives from a Hollow, a corrupt spirit that devours human souls.

Wounded during the fight against the Hollow, Rukia chooses the only option available to defeat the monster and passes her Shinigami powers to Ichigo. Now forced to act as a substitute until Rukia recovers, Ichigo hunts down the Hollows that plague his town.

In a remote mountain village under the watchful eyes of two stone guardians, the young Yuru contentedly lives off the land while staying close to the only family he has left—Asa, his precious twin sister. Asa, meanwhile, carries out a mysterious “duty” on behalf of the village while locked in a cage. Why is Asa a prisoner? And what other secrets does Yuru’s otherwise idyllic home hide?

(Source: Square Enix)

At the mysterious orphanage where Sheena lives, death is nothing new to its residents—girls who no longer have families of their own, who are raised as weapons of war, taught to kill and take the lives of others without batting an eye. Everyone, that is, except Sheena, who wishes for nothing more than the growing conflict around her to end. On the night of her roommate's death, Sheena meets a strange girl covered in blood, who smiles despite the turmoil surrounding them. The next day, the girl appears as a new student in Sheena's class and introduces herself as Mimi. Initially thought to be a school myth, there are now whispers in the orphanage's halls that Mimi is their secret weapon—an immortal who cannot die. When Mimi is later assigned as Sheena's new roommate, Sheena's world grows even more complicated when she begins living with someone who loves and welcomes death, when all Sheena wants to do is stop it…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

anilist_detail.synopsis: The second season of Seihantai na Kimi to Boku.

The fourth season of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken.

Demon Lord Rimuru's dream of creating an alliance between humans and monsters takes a step closer to being realized. As Tempest continues to prosper, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel Rozzo, clash with Demon Lord Rimuru over their plan to protect mankind by ruling over them. Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon works toward goals of his own. The awakening of a new Hero draws near!

(Source: Crunchyroll News)
The second season of Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu.

In an age when spies act behind the scenes in every land, Chloe spends her days successfully carrying out even the most difficult missions due to her unparalleled disguise skills and martial arts abilities. After the betrayal of her boss, she suddenly disappears—as Chloe plans to redo her life as the ordinary citizen Victoria in the neighboring kingdom of Ashberry, striving for a “normal” life. However, Victoria's peaceful life is abruptly cut short as she begins to get involved with many people. In this new land, her experiences and abilities from her days as a spy come in far more useful than she ever expected! On the other hand, the second prince--and others--take an interest in Victoria's strength, and the shadows close in on the woman with many faces…

(Source: Yen Press)

Jirou Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jirou is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Ragou, Jirou discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Ragou’s powers.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Mitsuki Aya has one goal at the elite Kuromi Girls’ Academy: to become a refined young lady like the school’s flawless “White Lily,” Yorue Mio. But her image of Mio shatters when Aya accidentally catches her...playing fighting games?! Turns out, the elegant Mio is actually a hardcore gamer—and she wants to duel Aya! The battle (and their friendship) begins.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Kakeru Sorano, a quiet university freshman who avoids others, meets Koharu Fuyutsuki, a blind girl who faces the world with quiet brightness. When she says, “I want to see fireworks someday,” something in Kakeru shifts. As they grow closer through small moments and shared loneliness, he searches for a way to make her wish come true.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

data_cache_episode.title: Burn Bright, Mad Dog
data_cache_episode.description: Ghislaine takes Eris to train under the Sword God, but Eris's brash attitude angers the other disciples.

data_cache_episode.title: Howl, Mad Dog
data_cache_episode.description: Nina continues to eye Eris as a rival, but training with masters of other styles sparks new discoveries.

data_cache_episode.title: Life Back at Home
data_cache_episode.description: Rudeus starts a new life with Roxy and Sylphiette, but not all his friends approve of his second marriage.

data_cache_episode.title: A King-Class Water Mage
data_cache_episode.description: Fearful of losing more loved ones, Rudeus begs Roxy to teach him a more potent form of magic.

data_cache_episode.title: Celebrations
data_cache_episode.description: Rudeus attends Cliff and Elinalise's wedding and goes shopping for his sisters' birthday presents.

data_cache_episode.title: Another Domestic Disaster?
data_cache_episode.description: Rudeus accompanies Roxy on a bodyguard mission and runs into an unexpected face from his past.

data_cache_episode.title: Phase Four
data_cache_episode.description: Following a successful summoning experiment, Nanahoshi offers Rudeus a reward.

data_cache_episode.title: The Disgrace of the Ducal House of Sanchez
data_cache_episode.description: Carolina Sanchez is given one option to redeem herself as a disgrace: to marry the Bloodthirty prince.
data_cache_episode.title_japanese: サンチェス公爵家の出来損ない

data_cache_episode.title: The Bloodthirty Second Prince
data_cache_episode.description: Leaving her country, Carolina heads for a rendezvous point to meet said Bloodthirsty Prince, when...

data_cache_episode.title: Founder`s Day Fete
data_cache_episode.description: With preparations for the Fete coming along, Carolina receives a letter from her father with surprising news.

data_cache_episode.title: Red Eyes and Ruby
data_cache_episode.description: Carolina expresses her gratitude towards her maid for all her hard work when a certain plan stirs Marisa.

data_cache_episode.title: Hidden Divinity
data_cache_episode.description: With the issue with Marielle resolved, Carolina now faces the moment of truth as she takes the aptitude test.

data_cache_episode.title: First Prince Gilbert
data_cache_episode.description: Gilbert's conditions improve thanks to Carolina, but unpleasant rumors of the two drives Edward to...

data_cache_episode.title: The Waver of the Perfect Young Lady
data_cache_episode.description: With Jonathan on her case, the Empire must find a way to prevent the Archbishop from taking Carolina away.

data_cache_episode.title: A Shinigami is Born!
data_cache_episode.description: Ichigo Kurosaki, a teenage boy who can see ghosts, helps a young girl ghost when some skateboarders knock over a vase offering for her. The next day Ichigo sees the young girl being chased by a big monster called a Hollow. Ichigo goes to help the girl but when the girl is just about to be eaten, a female Soul Reaper, Rukia Kuchiki, appears and saves them. That night Rukia visits Ichigo’s room and is surprised when she realizes she is visible to him. While they are conversing a Hollow appears and terorizes Ichigo’s family and household. After receiving a terrible injury from the Hollow, Rukia makes a final attempt to save her life, as well as that of the Kurosaki family and transfers her powers to Ichigo so he can save his family.
data_cache_episode.title_japanese: 死神になっちゃった日

data_cache_episode.title: Pay or Play
data_cache_episode.description: After the previous night's attack, Ichigo decides to check up on his family and finds that they do not remember anything that happened. In school, Ichigo meets the Soul Reaper from the night before, Rukia Kuchiki; she is posing as an exchange student until her powers return. Rukia tells Ichigo that he must take her place as a Soul Reaper for now. Later when attacking a Hollow, Ichigo recognizes the Hollow as Orihime Inoue’s older brother.

data_cache_episode.title: Sibling Rivalry
data_cache_episode.description: Orihime and her friend Tasuki are being attacked by a Hollow who was once Orihime's brother. Ichigo shows up and begins fighting with him. Orihime's brother is also struggling to gain control. Orihime is almost killed but her soul remains attached to her chain. Finally Orihime's brother gains control long enough to say one last goodbye to his sister before Ichigo sends his soul off to the Soul Society.
data_cache_episode.title_japanese: 兄の想い, 妹の想い
data_cache_episode.title_romaji: Ani no Omoi, Imouto no Omoi

data_cache_episode.title: Asa and Yuru
data_cache_episode.description: In a world where certain humans command mighty supernatural duos called Daemons, it is the birthright of "the children who sunder day and night"—twins Yuru and Asa—to rule over these powerful entities. Separated from a young age and unaware of the truth of their birth, brother and sister must fight to make their way back to each other, claim their birthright, and save the world...

data_cache_episode.title: Left and Right
data_cache_episode.description: Guided by Dera, Yuru flees from his pursuers and awakens the guardian deities of the village.

data_cache_episode.title: Dera and Hana
data_cache_episode.description: Yuru learns the truth about his village and learns the rules of modern society as he rides down the mountain.

data_cache_episode.title: Jin and Yuru
data_cache_episode.description: After a short rest, Yuru and his Daemons begin their search for Asa by sniffing out her blood.

data_cache_episode.title: Hare and Tortoise
data_cache_episode.description: Yuru and his Daemons track the scent of Asa's blood to a warehouse, where they encounter Jin and his men.

data_cache_episode.title: The Kagemori Clan and the Unknown Assailants
data_cache_episode.description: Yuru is reunited with Asa at the Kagemori mansion and asks her about their parents.

data_cache_episode.title: Asa and Break
data_cache_episode.description: The morning after the battle, Yuru asks about the eyepatch covering her right eye.

data_cache_episode.title: Suspicion and Conviction
data_cache_episode.description: Dera arrives at the Kagemori mansion to retrieve Yuru, and they're invited to breakfast by the clan head.

data_cache_episode.title: Embrace and Whisper
data_cache_episode.description: In order to cheer Yuru up, Dera drags him and his Daemons around the city to see the sights.
data_cache_episode.title_japanese: 抱擁と囁き[エンブレイスとウィスパー]

data_cache_episode.title: Long-Arm and Long-Leg
data_cache_episode.description: While shopping in the city, Yuru and Dera sense that they’re being followed.

data_cache_episode.title: Big Brother and Little Brother
data_cache_episode.description: After defeating Long-Arm and Long-Leg, the group realizes something else had been tailing them all along.

data_cache_episode.title: Retainer and Shaman
data_cache_episode.description: Ken moves in with Yuru and the others and asks Yuru to help him become stronger.

data_cache_episode.title: Daikyo and Shokyo
data_cache_episode.description: Higashi Village is attacked by a man wielding katana Daemons.

data_cache_episode.title: Family and Friends
data_cache_episode.description: Yuru and Ken notice someone following them while looking for a place to practice shooting a bow.

data_cache_episode.title: Yuru and Danji
data_cache_episode.description: Feeling betrayed by Danji, Yuru asks for space so he can think by himself.

data_cache_episode.title: Kagemori and Shingo
data_cache_episode.description: Yuru and Dera head to the warehouses at night to meet Ivan.

data_cache_episode.title: Crybaby and Naughty Child
data_cache_episode.description: The traitor attacks Asa while she's alone, but the Kagemoris have set a trap for him.

data_cache_episode.title: Fujin and Raijin
data_cache_episode.description: At the Kagemori mansion, the traitor is captured. Meanwhile, Gonzo overpowers the Shingo clan.

data_cache_episode.title: Christmas Eve
data_cache_episode.description: As their first Christmas Eve together approaches, Suzuki and Tani plan their date. They decide to challenge themselves to make a cake, and Suzuki's heart flutters as she watches how seriously Tani takes everything, and then...

data_cache_episode.title: Dilemma of a Winter`s Night
data_cache_episode.description: In the middle of winter break, Yamada grows anxious about the fact that his relationship with Nishi just hasn't made much progress. He uses homework as a pretext to see her, but he can't find the right timing to confess his feelings.

data_cache_episode.title: The Year That`s Passed, and the Year to Come
data_cache_episode.description: Tani tells his family that he's dating someone, and asks Suzuki over on New Year's Day. Flustered by the invitation, Suzuki makes one gaffe after another in front of his family. On the last day of winter break, the usual group of friends enjoy visiting a shrine together. Moved by Tani's words about living with no regrets, each of them step into the new year with hopes and feelings in their hearts.

data_cache_episode.title: New School Term
data_cache_episode.description: The new term begins. Taira realizes that he has been under a misconception for years. Suzuki takes Yamada to the school library, with an ulterior motive in mind. Nishi is happy that Yamada came, but anxious that others might find out about their relationship. When Honda asks what that relationship is, Nishi feels absolutely overwhelmed, but with a little nudge, Nishi realizes her true feelings.

data_cache_episode.title: Valentine`s Day
data_cache_episode.description: Though Yamada wants to confess his feelings to Nishi, he can't find the right timing. The two of them go on a date, and as Nishi turns things over in her mind, her feelings for Yamada swell. She blurts out, "I love you!" Yamada is taken aback by the sudden turn of events, but... Valentine's Day arrives and Suzuki gives Tani homemade cookies, but his too-honest reaction sends her into a sulk.

data_cache_episode.title: Threshold of Spring
data_cache_episode.description: When Taira hears that Yamada has a girlfriend, he’s able to offer his honest congratulations. Later, in the middle of a conversation, Taira is assailed by his past trauma. After the last day of the school year, Taira and Azuma head to a local restaurant together. Azuma realizes that she doesn’t want to lose her connection to Taira as she, along with everyone else, prepares to face the new season.

data_cache_episode.title: New Days
data_cache_episode.description: Tempest is thriving after the success of its festival, but unexpected trouble has arisen with the new dungeon.

data_cache_episode.title: The Dungeon Evolves
data_cache_episode.description: Rimuru and his trusted companions discuss ideas for improving the dungeon.
data_cache_episode.title_japanese: 進化する迷宮[ダンジョン]

data_cache_episode.title: The Avatar Team Is Formed
data_cache_episode.description: Rimuru, Ramiris, Veldora, and Milim work on perfecting their avatars before facing Team Green Fury.
data_cache_episode.title_japanese: 仮魔体[アバター]チーム結成

data_cache_episode.title: Invitation
data_cache_episode.description: The Council of the West deliberates on whether to grant membership to Tempest.

data_cache_episode.title: The First Step
data_cache_episode.description: Rimuru attends the meeting that will determine Tempest's membership in the Council of the West.

data_cache_episode.title: The Council of the West
data_cache_episode.description: A list of unreasonable demands from the Council makes Rimuru realize that a deeper plot is in motion.
data_cache_episode.title_japanese: 西方諸国評議会[カウンシル・オブ・ウェスト]

data_cache_episode.title: The Mastermind`s Identity
data_cache_episode.description: An interrogation of Prince Elric's would-be shooter reveals who's pulling the strings behind the Council.

data_cache_episode.title: The Groundwork of Greed
data_cache_episode.description: Glenda reveals all she knows about the Council and the Rozzos, and Rimuru prepares to inspect ancient ruins.

data_cache_episode.title: Investigating the Ruins
data_cache_episode.description: The investigation of the ancient ruins of Amrita begins.

data_cache_episode.title: The Master of Greed
data_cache_episode.description: Rimuru and Mirabel come face-to-face at last in the ancient ruins.

data_cache_episode.title: Milim`s Friend
